meta.title: MediQ — find listed Malaysian hospitals
meta.description: Information and navigation only. Browse listed Malaysian hospitals and send a consented information request. Not medical advice or emergency care.

home.title: Find listed Malaysian hospitals
home.intro: MediQ helps Bangladeshi patients browse provider-stated hospital services in Malaysia and send a consented information request. We do not diagnose or recommend treatment.
home.symptomsHelper: Search by hospital name or directory category. Do not enter symptoms.
home.betaNotice: General launch is not enabled. This is a limited beta until launch gates are approved.

filters.emptyBody: Browse a service category below. MediQ does not give medical advice.

profile.stale: Verification review is due. Confirm details with the provider.

request.title: Request information
request.name: Your name
request.warning: Do not send urgent messages or medical records. MediQ cannot handle emergencies or clinical documents.
request.successBody: We stored a minimised navigation request. Track status with your private link. You can also contact the hospital directly.
request.chooseOne: Choose a hospital or a category, not both.
request.errorConsent: Consent is required before we can route this request.
request.errorRate: Too many requests from this network. Please wait and try again.

status.title: Request status
status.invalid: This link is not valid. If you still need help, send a new request or contact the hospital directly.
status.notClinical: These statuses are operational only. They are not clinical updates.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: Browse listed hospitals, filter by name or service category, and optionally send a consented information request. MediQ does not triage, diagnose, or book care.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Use this form for listing, fee, or request-handling questions. Do not send medical records or urgent clinical questions.
contact.success: We recorded your message. This is not a clinical complaints process.

errors.notFoundBody: That page is not in the MediQ directory. Browse listed hospitals or return home.
errors.unexpectedBody: Please try again. If you need care now, contact local emergency services.

common.footerDisclaimer: MediQ is information and navigation only.
